user: the CI job keeps timing out on the e2e suite
assistant: The e2e job runs all 40 specs serially. I split it into 4 shards with --shard=N/4 in .github/workflows/ci.yml; the job now finishes in 6 minutes instead of 22. Merged as PR #118.
user: keep the shard count in one place
assistant: Moved it to the E2E_SHARDS repository variable.
docs.mission: Focus on technical decisions, architecture choices, project conventions, tooling setup, and recurring gotchas. Deprioritize transient debugging chatter.
